model_training_report.json.metric_note: F1/precision/recall refer to churn=Yes. Average precision is the non-interpolated PR summary, not trapezoidal PR-AUC. Validation metrics are used for selection and are optimistic; test metrics are the held-out assessment.

preprocessing.numeric_imputation: median fitted on training data only
preprocessing.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler for Logistic Regression; omitted for trees and dummy

provenance.decision_rule: Predict Yes when probability >= validation-F1 threshold. Ties prefer closest to 0.5, then higher threshold. Dummy keeps its native baseline rule.

model_training_report.json.selection_rule: Highest validation score after training-only cross-validation; configured model order breaks ties.

preprocessing.unknown_category_policy: StringIndexer keep; OHE drops unknown bucket to all-zero vector
StringIndexer keep; OHE drops unknown bucket to all-zero vector

spark_training_report.json.metric_note: Same sklearn metric functions for both engines: churn=Yes precision/recall/F1 and non-interpolated average precision. No Spark weighted-F1 or interpolated areaUnderPR substitution.
spark_training_report.json.timing_note: Local cached raw frames. Inference executes transform and collects actual probabilities and predictions. Includes JVM execution and collection, excludes metric calculation. First test action is retained separately; no multi-node speedup claim.
